text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I dunno! When I ran by the river, I got
caught up
in a baseball game and hit a
home run!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So they weren't... Tch. My dice must be
on the
highway by now.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe they wound up in the
back of a
long-haul truck. What'd you
have to chuck 'em so
hard for?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
When things get intense, I get carried
away, you
know? Anyway, it'd be simple
to just fold and
give up, but I'm not one
to back out of a game.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I totally get it! You wanted to play at
Koshien,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Nah, when we made that bet for our
trip, I
wanted to go wherever the dice
said.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Still, this game's starting to get
good. All I
wanted was to go where the
roll of the dice took
us. And it's taking
us to wherever that truck's
going.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then it's settled... We're going... to
America. A
pitch like yours was destined
for bigger fields
than the nationals, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if it's America, France, or
wherever.
We go where the dice take
us... Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
'Cause that's what betting on our destiny
means.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Woooo! That's why I love ya, Nakayama!
Just you
wait, Coach Golshi's gonna find
eight more ball
players for our team!
